scope: Independent algebra and bounded graph recomputation; not a full repetition of all Claude Monte Carlo trajectories. No grade upgrade or board placement.

step_checks.derivation: Let B be signed vertex-edge incidence (A +, B -), U unsigned incidence, H=1+qb. Q=eps*(Un-H), sigma=eps*(H-Uc). Thus B(n-c)=Q+sigma; sum_X cancels internal edges. A flip adds dn to both endpoints, hence changes charges by +dn,-dn regardless of H. On a closed four-regular bipartite host |A|=|B|, sum Q=-sum eps*qb.

step_checks.grade: PROVED for unrestricted real reference; equality of minimum charge remains empirical
step_checks.derivation: For connected bipartite host, ker(U^T)=span(eps). Uc=H is solvable over reals iff eps.H=0 per component. This does not promise bounded c or binary n. Triangle inequality gives sum |Q|>=|I|. Enumerated all K4,4 degree patterns and labels.

step_checks.grade: Retain first-check downgrades and supplied-block scope
step_checks.derivation: Layer charge is +16/-16 on diamond L4, diagonal square factors number 474 and column factors 738. Counterexample f11=5/4, others=1/4 on K4,4 gives zero layer for written {a0,b0}; the universal endpoint-reference prohibition is false. Finite-range argument requires a common local rule across arbitrarily thick/mirrored slabs with prescribed bulk behaviour; one finite slab alone cannot establish all-range nonlocality.

Birth keeps old d and gives both new d=2. Shared newborn qb gives (+1-qb,-1+qb). Undo reverses this on admissible branches. Hop, admission, release and absorption do not alter n or fixed labels; Bind changes q but not Q under fixed region labels. These are algebraic move checks, not falsely counted as simulated transitions. 576 fully-written K4,4 guard-passing births reproduced.

Relabelling changes Q by -eps*dqb. Own-record write gives one unit; majority relabelling can change neighbours on only one sublattice. Q total depends on the label set, not automatically the physical written set. 'Exactly Z opposite units' means a NET compensation, not exclusion of additional neutral pairs.
Gauss accounting does not determine field energy, entropy cost, or equal effective interaction strengths in two backgrounds.

disagreements_with_first_check: No numerical disagreement in independently recomputed targets. First-check corrections are supported.

Qualification: unrestricted real layer-free references, net versus absolute compensating charge, and finite-range rule quantifiers must be explicit. Unrepeated ring sampling and full move enumerations are not independently certified here.
corrections: Keep S9 universal endpoint-reference claim REFUTED; S16 conditional on label set. Keep labels and relabelling rule unresolved; do not adopt a principal definition.
A static-reference identity is not by itself a derived electrodynamic Gauss constraint or equal coupling measurement. No card upgrade.
plain_summary: The common integer charge unit and Gauss accounting check out when background labels stay fixed. My independent enumeration reproduces 474 diagonal-band and 738 column-band home patterns, and the diamond block's opposite boundary layers of 16 units. I also reproduce the counterexample to the claim that every local reference must leave a layer. Changing background labels can change net charge; the rule for doing that remains unresolved. These are conditional accounting results, not a measurement of equal forces in both backgrounds. Keep the existing grades and the first check's downgrades.
